div.div:
Training (Teacher Forcing):
- Video chunks conditioned on clean past latents
- Both video and action denoised jointly
- Flow matching objective: predict velocity v(t)
- State features enter as register tokens in self-attn
- CLIP image + UMT5 text enter as cross-attn KV
